_comment: Positive-frame compatibility reel. PARKED — do not queue or post. Posts only once BOTH (a) the 8-day 17s card-reel run has finished, and (b) the comment-to-DM mechanic is running (manually at first, automated once Meta App Review clears). Interleaving it with the card run would contaminate the only clean test of the 17s rebuild.
_provenance: Pairs are DERIVED, never authored. Source of truth is vedic-numerology/lib/numerology/friendship.ts. A pair qualifies only when BOTH rows list the other as a friend (mutual), which is why 1&7 and 2&9 are absent despite appearing in one direction. Regenerate with scripts/derive-compatibility-pairs.mjs after any change to that table — do not hand-edit this list.
_whyPositive: Instagram field research 2026-08-06: the aspirational frame carries the niche (same-account control: compatibility 51.9-57.2K views vs 6.8-25.9K for everything else on @numberswithrimzim, 28.6K followers). Conflict-framed equivalents landed 1,115-1,436 likes. A conflict list from our ruleset would also visibly contradict the loudest posts in the niche (they cite 1-8, 2-8, 8-9; we derive 1&3, 4&9, 7&9 — only 4&9 overlaps), inviting 'that's wrong' replies. See memory: numevix-compatibility-content-research.

hook.line1: Why do some couples just work?
hook.line2: In Vedic numerology only 7 pairs match both ways.
hook._rule: Asks WHY, not WHETHER — 'Do you...?' invites a no and a scroll. Must be legible at frame 0 and must NOT animate in: useSnap is a spring from zero, so the first frame of any animated scene is invisible.
hook._searchVocabulary: numerology compatibility · birth number match · moolank compatibility — nobody outside India searches 'moolank' alone.

pairs.why: One decides, one reads the room.
The leader and the one who spots what everyone missed.
Both feel more than they say — and neither minds the quiet.
One knows the way, the other has the nerve to go.
Sudden ideas, patient hands. Nothing gets dropped.
Softness and fire, and each keeps the other honest.

_selfPairs.note: Numbers that list THEMSELVES as friendly: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9. Notably 7 does NOT — 7's friends are [2,3,6]. Held back from the reel as a second post rather than crowding this one.
_selfPairs.hookIfUsed: Eight numbers get on with their own kind. One doesn't.

closing.line: Not on the list? It doesn't mean no.
closing._why: The mutual list is a strong claim; without this line the ~2/3 of viewers whose pair is absent read it as a verdict against them and bounce. This is the same reason Barnum hooks were rejected — never leave a verdict on the reader.

cta.caption:
Comment your birth number (or your full date of birth — I'll work it out) and I'll send your best matches in the DM.

Only comments with a number will trigger it.
cta._mechanic: Comment-to-DM. The research finding was that this mechanic — not the hook — is what separates 57K from 1.4K: 2,953 comments against 673 likes is a 4.4:1 ratio that cannot happen organically. Ours has always asked for a comment and offered nothing back.
cta._manualInterim: Until Meta App Review clears, this is fulfilled BY HAND. Volume is the point of the test, not the burden — if it is unmanageable by hand, that is the signal the mechanic works.
cta._keywordBlock: love compatibility, numerology compatibility, birth number match, soulmate numerology, partner compatibility, relationship numerology, moolank compatibility, couple compatibility
cta._keywordBlockNote: Plain-text comma-separated block in the caption, NOT hashtag spam — 3-5 hashtags max. Both top accounts in the niche do exactly this (one in parentheses, one in square brackets).

footer._rule: The post is the value; promotion is a footer. Link in bio only — the domain does not appear before the last beat.

music._constraint: Soft, not EDM. Generate, never the marketplace. mool-2 is a REJECTED bed; mool-3 is rejected-but-reinstated for ONE slot only and that slot is spent. Cuts must snap to a TRACKED beat map, never a computed grid.

narration._why: Owner decision 2026-08-06: silent, music + text. Costs zero ElevenLabs credits (~29.8K of 40,000 remain). The Reels tab is watched muted and 91.8% of our viewers there are non-followers, so every word that must land is burned into the frame anyway.
